name: skif
description: Lint JavaScript and TypeScript monorepo dependencies with skif: workspace, manifest, version and catalog rules, and unused or unlisted dependencies, files and exports, with format-preserving fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Dependency linter for JavaScript and TypeScript monorepos
interface.longDescription: Runs skif to find version mismatches, manifest problems, catalog drift and unused or unlisted dependencies, files and exports in npm, pnpm, yarn and bun workspaces, reads its JSON report, and applies its fixes.
defaultPrompt: Lint this monorepo's dependencies with skif.
Why does skif report this dependency as unused?
Migrate this repository from sherif, syncpack and knip to skif.
